notes: Two different fathers are written only as «أبي»: the compiler's own (occurrence 1) and the father of Muhammad b. Abi Umar (occurrence 3); neither is named and neither is merged.
«محمد بن أبي عمر» and «أبي صالح» contain the word «أبي» inside names and are names, not relations.
The Companion Ibn Abbas is the last link; the saying is his exegesis.
